formulas.ascii: Each step is one midpoint (RK2) step p1 = p + h * v(p + h/2 * v(p)) with h = timeStep * speedScale, where v bilinearly interpolates the (u, v) cell centres of the field (row 0 at the smallest y, clamped to the outermost centres). The field and h share one unit system: here the field is in degrees per hour and timeStep is 2 hours, so p is lon/lat degrees. A particle respawns instead of stepping when any of the three samples (p, midpoint, landing) is outside the field or touches a NaN cell, when its age reaches maximumAge (0 = never), when its speed is below minimumSpeed, or with probability dropRate; this run uses none of those and no particle left the field. Trail slot frame % L receives the new position.
